speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyelonephritis

Based on your history of antibiotic-treated sinusitis followed by persistent fever, flank pain, and a rash, the clinical picture strongly suggests an ascending kidney infection (pyelonephritis) rather than a relapse of sinusitis. The rash could indicate an allergic reaction to the antibiotic or be a concurrent viral exanthem, but the localized flank pain and fever point to the kidneys. I have already requested a Urinalysis; please wait for the results to confirm the presence of bacteria and white blood cells before we finalize the treatment plan.
